title: SCA Minhag of the Week 305: "Reciting Yag Midot Before Taking Out the Torah on Yamim Noraim"

chapters.title: Customs of Yud Gimmel Middot and Halab
chapters.about: Yud Gimmel Middot before taking out the Torah and the Halabi custom according to Derech Eretz

chapters.title: Reports from Halabi Authorities and Brazil
chapters.about: Reports from Hachams, the 1961 incident in Brazil, and exceptions in Halabi nusah and letters

chapters.title: Conclusion on the Prevalent Custom
chapters.about: Summary of the Halabi custom not to recite Yud Gimmel Middot and the minyan practice

summary: This class discusses whether to recite Yud Gimmel Middot before taking out the Sefer Torah on Yamim Noraim and other holidays. It examines the custom of Halab based on various reports and authorities, contrasting it with the view of the Mekubalim.
questions: Should Yud Gimmel Middot be recited before taking out the Sefer Torah on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur?
What was the traditional custom in Halab regarding Yud Gimmel Middot at Petihat HaEikhal?
How do the Mekubalim view reciting Yud Gimmel Middot on holidays like Pesach, Shavuot, and Sukkot?
What happened in the Halabi community in Brazil in 1961 when the Hazzan started to recite Yud Gimmel Middot?
